blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Tax quietly shapes many business decisions. How you price a product can change the VAT it carries. Where you open an office can change the tax the company pays. How you structure a big deal can change who pays and when.

Tax is rarely the main reason for a decision. But it is often a meaningful secondary one. Two options can look equal at first. Once you add tax, they can become very different.

You do not need to be a tax expert to lead a business. You do need to know when to ask a simple question: does this change the tax picture, and by how much? Good leaders bring a tax expert into the conversation early — usually earlier than most people think.

items.q: According to the text, what does tax do to business decisions?
options: It is always the main reason
It has no effect on them
items.why: "Tax quietly shapes many business decisions."

items.q: How is tax described in the text?
options: As the main reason for most decisions
items.why: "Tax is rarely the main reason… But it is often a meaningful secondary one."

items.q: When two options look equal, what can change them?
items.why: "Once you add tax, they can become very different."

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: You should call a tax expert only at the very end
Leaders should ask about the tax picture
Two equal options can differ after tax
Tax can affect where you open an office
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz para trazer o especialista mais cedo — deixar para o fim contraria a mensagem.

items.q: The text suggests that a good leader…
options: knows the right moment to ask for tax help
always picks the cheapest option first
must be a full tax expert
items.why: Inferência: você não precisa ser especialista, mas precisa saber a hora de chamar um.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James mostrando os números ao novo diretor comercial. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Come and look at this with me. You want to open the new office across the border, and I understand why. The rent is lower, and the salaries are a little lower too. On paper, it looks cheaper.

But we only looked at the costs. We did not look at the tax. So let me add it now.

The corporate tax over there is higher. And because the office sells to clients here, we pay tax on both sides. When I put those numbers in, the office is not cheaper anymore. It is actually a little more expensive.

I am not saying no. Maybe there is a good reason to be in that country. But the reason cannot be "it is cheaper," because after tax, it is not.

So here is what I want. Before you sign anything, let us talk to the tax team. Ten minutes now can save us a very expensive surprise later. That is the whole point — we bring them in early, not after the deal is done.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Why did the new office look cheaper at first?
options: The rent and salaries were lower
items.why: "The rent is lower, and the salaries are a little lower too."

items.q: What did they forget to look at?
items.why: "But we only looked at the costs. We did not look at the tax."

items.q: After James adds the tax, the new office is…
items.why: "After tax… it is actually a little more expensive."

items.q: What does James suggest doing before signing?
items.why: Inferência: "Before you sign anything, let us talk to the tax team."

items.q: What is James's main point?
options: Bring the tax team in early, not late
The office is a bad idea
items.why: Inferência: ele não diz não; ele quer o especialista cedo para evitar surpresas caras.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Tax can shape a business decision." To shape means to…
items.why: To shape = moldar, influenciar a forma de algo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "How you ___ a product can change the tax it carries."
items.why: To price = precificar; definir o preço muda o imposto.

items.q: "They want to open a new office across the border." An office is…
items.why: Office = escritório, o lugar de trabalho.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "How you ___ a big deal can change who pays and when."
items.why: To structure = estruturar; organizar o desenho do negócio.

items.q: "Tax is a secondary reason." Secondary means…
items.why: Secondary = secundário; importante, mas não o principal.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem em reuniões de negócios. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The CFO has to sign off on the deal." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o aval.

items.q: "We will roll out the new plan next month." To roll out means to…
items.why: Roll out = colocar em prática, lançar.

items.q: "Two managers pushed back on the idea." They…
items.why: Push back on = resistir, discordar.

items.q: "Let us bring in the tax team early." To bring in means to…
items.why: Bring in = trazer alguém para ajudar na conversa.

items.q: "Ten minutes now can save us from a heads-up that comes too late." A heads-up is…
items.why: Heads-up = um aviso antecipado sobre algo que vem.
